Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Tetragrammaton wrote:
> Hello, a little clarification as per subject:
> is tainted spring usable with the retainer recruiting action
> done with jack of both sides ?
> Think answer is no (as per the clarifications given in the past about TS
> with
> summoning/muricia's call) but i would like to get a confirmation here.

Jack of Both Sides is an action to employ a named retainer from your hand
(unlike Summoning/Muricia's Call, which are "search for and employ/recruit"
actions).

If you name an animal retainer with Jack, that action is an "employ animal"
action, and Tainted Spring can be used.

Bestial Vengeance
Type: Combat
Requires: laibon Animalism
Requires a Laibon.
[ani] Only usable before range is determined. Choose a retainer on
this Laibon. This combat, this Laibon is immune to frenzy cards and
the opposing minion takes 1 damage during strike resolution if the
retainer is ready. A vampire can play only one Bestial Vengeance each
combat.
[ANI] As above, but for 2 damage.

Tainted Spring
Type: Action Modifier
Requires: Animalism
Cost: 1 blood
[ani] Only usable when an action to employ or recruit an animal is
announced. If this action is successful, the animal gets +1 strength
(for an ally) or inflicts an additional damage (for damage-dealing
retainers).
[ANI] As above, and the animal gets an additional starting life.

> As [Tainted Spring] mentions damage dealing retainers, if an owl companion was to

Yes, but moot, since the Owl doesn't deal damage.

> Is this a pervasive effect?
>
> How does this interact with BV?

BV deals damage under certain conditions. It doesn't, however, make the Owl a
damage-dealing retainer.
